summary.text: Laurie Pohutsky is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 17, a member of the Michigan House since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as a scientist with a background in laboratory and quality control work.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Pohutsky was born in Detroit and earned a bachelor's degree in microbiology from Michigan State University in 2010.

Her career experience includes working as a customer service specialist and laboratory technician with Armune BioScience, a laboratory technician with National Surgical Healthcare and Millennium Health, and a quality control technician with Neogen Corporation.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Pohutsky described herself as a millennial microbiologist who had worked in toxicology, health care and food safety.
She chaired the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee in 2023-2024, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the House Oversight Committee.
